note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (simulated text, fictional commentator, no real citation). Relationship kinds are supplied by the author; no causal link is drawn unless supplied.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Catalogue search, both shelves, source page, linked passage ¶2, pinpoint tab and commentator’s card; the marker runs from the search to the source shelf and page, down to the passage, across the gutter to the pinpoint and into the card, which enlarges its pinpoint.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different fictional rule and commentator linked to ¶3; the relationships are traced from the commentary side (search → commentaries → card → pinpoint → passage → page) and the focus is the linked passage; the shelves are drawn as a reading sequence rather than search results.

passages: Documents are filed with the registry office.
Each document carries a filing number.
The registry records the day of filing.
A filed document may be inspected by the parties.
sources.commentaryText: Reads “records the day” as meaning the calendar day, not the hour.

params.query: article 7 written notice between the parties — commentary

sources.sourceTitle: Article 7 — Notices, communications and addresses of the parties
passages: Each party names in writing a postal address and an electronic address for notices.
Notice is given in writing, is signed by the sender and states the date on which it is sent.
The sender keeps a copy of every notice together with any proof of dispatch.
sources.commentaryWork: Annotated Notes on the Example Code of Obligations
sources.commentaryText: Reads the words “in writing” in this passage as also covering email messages that identify the sender.

passages: Cada parte indica una dirección para avisos.
El aviso se da por escrito e indica la fecha de envío.
Quien envía el aviso conserva una copia.
sources.commentaryText: Entiende que «por escrito» incluye aquí el correo electrónico.
